## Chi-square test for mouse
**Data Importation and tidying**
The Mouse data was imported using the read.csv() function and the data was tidied using the subset() function of the dplyr package.

```{r Data Mouse,echo=TRUE,results='hide',warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
Ms<-read.csv("mouse.csv",header=T)
Ms<-Ms[-c(1),]
attach(Ms)
Ms<-subset(Ms,select=-BW);Ms
detach(Ms)
```

**chi-square analysis of the p-value from the mouse data**
Since its a backcross the expected genotype ratio is 2:2 which means 50%:50%.

```{r chi-square, echo=TRUE}
exp<-c(0.5,0.5)
p.value<-rep(NA,14)
for (m in 1:14){
  obs<- table( Ms[,m] )
  p.value[m]<-chisq.test(x=obs,p=exp,correct=T)$p.value
}
p.value[m]
```

**Heatmap of the marker from mouse data**
This was created with the marker and the individual data from the mouse data

```{r Heatmap, echo=TRUE,warning=FALSE}
image(as.matrix(Ms),ylab="Markers",Xlab="Individual",col=c("yellow","blue"))
```

**Plot of the p-vaues obtained for each marker with abline at normal and bonferroni corrected significance level** 
The output with the bonferroni correction shows that the marker loci segregated as expected for the mouse data.

```{r plots, echo=TRUE}
table(p.value<0.05)
table(p.value<0.05/14)
plot(sort(p.value))
abline(h = c(0.05, 0.05/14), col = c("red", "blue"))
legend("topleft", legend=c("alpha = 0.05", "alpha* = 0.05/14"), col=c("red", "blue"), lty=1)

```

## Chi-square test for maize
**Data Importation and tidying**
The Maize data was imported using the read.csv() function and the data was tidied using the [] operator.

```{r}
Ma<-read.csv("maize.csv",header=T)
Ma<-Ma[-c(1,14)]
```

**chi-square analysis of the p-value from the mouse data**
Since its a F2 population the expected genotype ratio is 1:2:1 which means 25%:50%:25%.

```{r}
exp<-c(0.25,0.5,0.25)
p.value<-rep(NA,12)
for (n in 1:12){
  obs<- table( Ma[,n] )
  p.value[n]<-chisq.test(x=obs,p=exp,correct=T)$p.value
}
p.value[n]
```

**Heatmap of the marker from maize data**
This was created with the marker and the individual data from the mouse data

```{r,warning=FALSE}
image(as.matrix(Ms),ylab="Markers",Xlab="Individual",col=c("yellow","blue"))
```

**Plot of the p-vaues obtained for each marker with abline at normal and bonferroni corrected significance level** 

```{r}
table(p.value<0.05)
table(p.value<0.05/12)
plot(sort(p.value))
abline(h = c(0.05, 0.05/12), col = c("red", "blue"))
legend("topleft", legend=c("alpha = 0.05", "alpha* = 0.05/12"), col=c("red", "blue"), lty=1)
```
